reminders.title: Come Back to Salah
reminders.message: Whatever today brings, take a moment to pause, pray, and reconnect with Allah.

reminders.title: Find Peace in Sajdah
reminders.message: When the world feels heavy, place your worries down in Sajdah.

reminders.title: Make Time for Salah
reminders.message: Life will always keep you busy. Let Salah remind you what truly matters.

reminders.title: Five Moments of Peace
reminders.message: Five prayers. Five beautiful opportunities each day to pause and return to Allah.

reminders.title: Answer the Call
reminders.message: When it is time for Salah, leave the world behind for a few moments and turn towards Allah.

reminders.title: A Verse for Your Heart
reminders.message: Open the Quran today. Perhaps one Ayah is the reminder your heart has been waiting for.

reminders.title: A Little Every Day
reminders.message: You don't need to read much. Begin with a few verses and keep going.

reminders.title: Read. Reflect. Grow.
reminders.message: Don't just read the Quran. Pause, understand, and carry its guidance into your day.

reminders.title: One Ayah Today
reminders.message: Begin with one Ayah. A beautiful Quran habit can start with something small.

reminders.title: Make Time for Quran
reminders.message: Give a few minutes of your day to the Quran and a little less to the noise around you.

reminders.title: Speak to Allah
reminders.message: You don't need perfect words. Speak sincerely and let your heart make the Dua.

reminders.title: Never Stop Asking
reminders.message: Whatever you are carrying today, place it before Allah in Dua.

reminders.title: A Quiet Conversation
reminders.message: Take a moment away from everything. Raise your hands and speak to Allah.

reminders.title: Ask With Hope
reminders.message: Make Dua with hope, patience, and trust in Allah.

reminders.title: Remember Others
reminders.message: As you make Dua for yourself today, remember your family, friends, and those in need.

reminders.title: Remember Allah
reminders.message: Keep your tongue busy with Dhikr and your heart connected to Allah.

reminders.title: A Moment of Dhikr
reminders.message: Pause for a moment. Say SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar.

reminders.title: Remember Throughout the Day
reminders.message: Between life's busy moments, make a little space for the remembrance of Allah.

reminders.title: Say Alhamdulillah
reminders.message: Before asking for more, take a moment to thank Allah for what you already have.

reminders.title: Notice the Blessings
reminders.message: Some of life's greatest blessings are the ones we forget to notice. Say Alhamdulillah.

reminders.title: Begin With Gratitude
reminders.message: A grateful heart sees blessings even in the smallest things.

reminders.title: Hold On to Sabr
reminders.message: Not everything will happen when you expect it. Be patient and keep trusting Allah.

reminders.title: One Day at a Time
reminders.message: You don't have to solve everything today. Have Sabr and take the next right step.

reminders.title: Trust the Journey
reminders.message: When you cannot see what comes next, continue with patience, prayer, and trust.

reminders.title: Return to Allah
reminders.message: Yesterday's mistakes don't have to define today. Seek forgiveness and begin again.

reminders.title: Ask for Forgiveness
reminders.message: Take a quiet moment today to say Astaghfirullah sincerely.

reminders.title: Begin Again
reminders.message: Every day is another opportunity to repent, improve, and come closer to Allah.

reminders.title: Choose Kindness
reminders.message: A gentle word may be the best part of someone's day. Choose kindness.

reminders.title: Beautiful Character
reminders.message: Let your faith be seen in your honesty, patience, kindness, and the way you treat others.

reminders.title: Guard Your Words
reminders.message: Before you speak, ask whether your words will bring goodness or unnecessary hurt.

reminders.title: Leave Goodness Behind
reminders.message: Wherever you go today, leave behind kindness, respect, and something beneficial.

reminders.title: Remember Your Parents
reminders.message: Call them, help them, make Dua for them, and speak to them with kindness.

reminders.title: Make Dua for Them
reminders.message: Take a moment today to make a sincere Dua for your parents.

reminders.title: Give Something Today
reminders.message: A little kindness, time, help, or charity can make someone's day easier.

reminders.title: Be Someone's Ease
reminders.message: If you can make someone's burden lighter today, don't miss the opportunity.

reminders.title: Small Acts Matter
reminders.message: Never underestimate a small act of goodness done with a sincere intention.

reminders.title: Remember What Lasts
reminders.message: The world keeps us busy. Take a moment today to remember the Akhirah.

reminders.title: Invest in Your Akhirah
reminders.message: Do something today that you hope to meet again as a good deed.

reminders.title: What Will You Carry?
reminders.message: Another day is passing. Fill part of it with something that benefits your Akhirah.

reminders.title: Blessed Jummah
reminders.message: Make this Friday meaningful with Salah, Quran, Dhikr, Dua, and good deeds.

reminders.title: A Friday Reminder
reminders.message: Step away from the week's distractions and make time today to remember Allah.

reminders.title: Keep the Connection Alive
reminders.message: Pray your Salah. Read the Quran. Make Dua. Keep your connection with Allah alive.

reminders.title: Three Beautiful Habits
reminders.message: Namaz for your soul. Quran for your guidance. Dua from your heart.

reminders.title: A Few Minutes for Allah
reminders.message: Among everything you have planned today, keep some time for Salah, Quran, and Dua.

reminders.title: Reconnect
reminders.message: Feeling distracted? Pause, remember Allah, and begin again.

reminders.title: Start With Bismillah
reminders.message: Begin with Bismillah, move with good intention, and end with Alhamdulillah.

reminders.title: Small Steps
reminders.message: One prayer on time. One page of Quran. One sincere Dua. Keep moving forward.

reminders.title: Make Today Meaningful
reminders.message: Give a little time today to worship, reflection, kindness, and gratitude.

reminders.title: Protect Your Connection
reminders.message: Don't let a busy life leave your heart too busy to remember Allah.

reminders.title: End the Day Well
reminders.message: Before you sleep, remember Allah, seek forgiveness, and make Dua for tomorrow.
